results.releaseNotes:
Shared recipes now import exactly as they were written.

FIXED: Steps no longer go missing
A step with no time or water of its own, the kind that just tells you what to do, used to disappear when you imported a recipe. Every step now comes through, in order, with whatever the sender wrote.

FIXED: Pours written as a range
A pour given as a window rather than a single moment now lands in the middle of that window instead of being skipped.

BETTER: More of the bag travels with the recipe
Imports now read the roaster who produced the coffee, the basket a shot was pulled in, and the language a bag's notes were written in.

One you may not have found yet: any recipe in BrewSmart can be shared as a link, and whoever opens it gets the whole thing, beans included.

Plus reliability improvements and fixes throughout. Still free. No ads, no subscriptions.
results.description:
BrewSmart is your complete coffee brewing companion. Calculate the ratio, get coached through every pour, log the cup, then dial in the next one — and share the winner as a link that opens right in a friend's BrewSmart. All in one fast, focused app. No ads. No subscriptions.

Adjust water, coffee, or ratio and the other two update instantly. Perfect for pour over (V60, Chemex, Kalita), AeroPress, French press, moka pot, drip, and espresso — whether you're dialing in a new single-origin or scaling up a batch.

THE BREWING LOOP

1. Calculate — Tap or swipe water, coffee, or ratio; the others recalculate instantly. No keyboard, no guessing. Precise to 0.1 g.
2. Brew — Turn any recipe into a guided, step-by-step pour with target weights, timing cues, and a live countdown to your next pour.
3. Log — Save every brew to your journal with a rating, notes, grind, and temperature. Edit any detail later.
4. Dial in — Tell BrewSmart how the cup tasted — too sour or bitter, weak or strong — and get a specific adjustment for your next brew.

FEATURES

Brew Calculator
Tap or swipe any value — water, coffee, or ratio — and the other two recalculate instantly, precise to 0.1 g.

Pour Guide
Turn any recipe into a step-by-step guided brew with target weights and timing cues. Start from the built-in pour schedule, or build your own pours with a bloom and custom targets. A live countdown ticks down to your next pour. Or keep it simple with the plain timer.

Share Recipes by Link
Send any recipe as a link — it unfurls with a preview in the chat, and whoever taps it can see the pour schedule, grind, and temperature, then save and brew it. Has a coffee attached? Its details come along, so they can make your exact cup. No BrewSmart? The link opens as a web page. Coffees share the same way — on their own or with their recipes. Prefer a picture? Any recipe or journal entry becomes a clean, themed card.

Coffee Library
Keep every coffee you brew: roaster, origin, process, varietals, roast level and roast date, plus your own tasting notes. Attach a coffee to recipes and logged brews, then look back at every cup you made with it.

Dial-In Assistant
Brewed something off? Mark the taste — sour, bitter, weak, or strong — and BrewSmart recommends exactly what to change next time: grind, dose, ratio, temperature, or time. Apply it with one tap.

Brew Journal
Log every cup with a rating, tasting notes, grind, water temperature — and the coffee you brewed with. Add brews by hand or straight from the timer, and edit any detail later.

Recipe Collection
Browse a hand-picked collection of recipes — classics like the 4:6 Method, hot and iced — right from the recipes screen, and save any of them into your app.

Apple Watch Brew Coach
Start a guided brew from your wrist and follow the pour coach with haptic cues for every pour — no need to touch your phone mid-brew. Real-time sync keeps your watch and iPhone together.

Home Screen Widgets
Jump straight to your ratio or timer from the Home Screen.

Lock Screen Live Activity
Keep your pour timer and next-pour countdown on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.

Siri & Shortcuts
Ask Siri to calculate your ratio or start a brew timer hands-free.

Recipe Management
Save your favorite water, coffee, and ratio combinations — plus grind and temperature — as named recipes. Attach one of your coffees, load any saved setup with a single tap, and edit every detail. Rename or delete anytime.

Brew Timer
Count-up timer with start, pause, resume, and reset — right on the main screen.

Grams or Ounces, °C or °F
Switch weight between grams and ounces and temperature between °C and °F — across the app, widgets, and Apple Watch.

Clean & Focused
No ads. No subscriptions. Light and dark mode. Optimized for iPhone and Apple Watch.

—

Whether you're calibrating your V60, dialing in espresso, or just making a better cup every morning, BrewSmart takes you from ratio to perfect brew — and remembers what worked.

results.description:
LinkClean strips tracking junk from any link, so what you share is the clean destination — not a trail of who shared it, from where, and when.

Paste a link and LinkClean instantly removes tracking parameters like utm_source, fbclid, gclid, and dozens more. You see exactly what was taken out and what's left, then copy a clean link with a single tap.

CLEAN FROM ANYWHERE
You don't have to open the app to clean a link:
• Share Sheet — tap Share in any app, pick Clean URL, and the tidied link is on your clipboard
• Safari — clean the link of the page you're on right from the toolbar, then copy it, copy as Markdown, or share
• Shortcuts & Siri — clean links inside your own automations, hands-free
• Control Center & Home Screen widget — one tap cleans whatever you've copied
• Copy link as… — plain, Markdown [title](url) with the page title filled in, or your own format

CLEANING THAT GOES DEEPER
LinkClean does more than trim the obvious tags:
• Unwraps redirect links to find and clean the real destination
• Strips trackers hiding after the # in a link
• Expands short links too — turn on Short-Link Expansion and LinkClean follows bit.ly, t.co, and the like to the real page before cleaning it (free, off by default, and the one feature that reaches the web — always your choice)

SCAN & MAKE QR CODES
• Scan a QR code to clean the link hidden inside it
• Turn any clean link into a fresh QR code to share

SEE YOUR IMPACT
Every clean shows a calm summary of how many trackers were removed — tap to see exactly which ones, and tap a leftover to strip it from now on. The Statistics dashboard adds it all up over time, with a privacy card you can share.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Turn the built-in tracker list on or off
• Add your own parameters to always remove
• Keep a searchable History of everything you've cleaned — copy, share, re-clean, or reopen any link, and tap one to see exactly what changed, before and after

ONE PURCHASE, YOURS FOREVER
LinkClean is free to use: unlimited cleaning, the Share Sheet and Shortcuts actions, one custom rule of your own, and your last 7 days of History. LinkClean Pro unlocks your own copy formats, unlimited custom rules, and your full History archive — a single one-time purchase. No subscription, no account, nothing recurring.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Cleaning happens entirely on your device, and the full links you clean never leave it — not the path, the parameters, or any values. The one exception is Short-Link Expansion, which reaches the web only when you switch it on. LinkClean uses only anonymous, aggregate analytics to learn which features matter; the one thing it notes about a cleaned link is its site domain (like youtube.com), never the full link. See the privacy policy for the full picture.

Built for iOS 26 with a fast, native, Liquid Glass interface.

—

Privacy Policy: https://ken0nek.com/apps/linkclean/privacy-policy/

results.description:
When your child asks a why-question, Whyzard gives you two layers, side by side — a calm, kid-friendly answer you can read together, and a real adult-level explanation underneath. So you're not reciting; you're learning alongside them.

HOW IT WORKS

• Type or speak any question your child has asked, or one you're both curious about: "Why is the sky blue?" "Why can birds fly?" "Why can't I have ice cream before dinner?"
• Get a two-layer answer in seconds — a kid-friendly framing first, your own deeper layer underneath.
• The kid-facing answer, read aloud.
• An honest note flags what the answer leaves out, and when your child will be ready for that next layer.
• Follow-up suggestions help you go deeper if either of you stays curious.
• After each answer, a few open-ended questions to ask your child back — each with a quick answer ready for you.
• A starter question every day, in case you want a fresh question to explore together.

LEARN TOGETHER, IN TWO LAYERS

The for-your-child layer is the words you can read aloud together — tuned to how your child takes in ideas, from first plain-spoken explanations to a well-read kid ready for bigger words. Set your child's level once, and every answer comes back fitted to them.

The just-for-you layer is a real explanation written for the parent — as deep as you want, from a quick gist to the full mechanism behind it. You and your child learn together, instead of you relaying a script you don't fully understand.

BUILT FOR CURIOSITY — LEARNED TOGETHER

The why-questions kids ask all day — about sky, weather, animals, space, bodies, dreams, why things work the way they do. Each one becomes a moment to wonder about together.

WHY IT'S NOT ANOTHER CHATBOT

• Built for two readers, not one. Open it with your child — answer on screen, conversation in the room.
• No account, no sign-up, no waiting. Open the app, ask, read together.
• Your conversation history stays on your device.

SIRI-READY

"Hey Siri, ask Whyzard why the sky is blue." A calm answer comes back on screen.

ASK IN ANY LANGUAGE

Whyzard auto-detects the language of each question and answers in the same language.

—

Whyzard is for the questions kids ask and parents don't always have words for. Open it together. Read it together. Keep wondering together.

—

Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

results.description:
Rondo turns the counting numbers into a quiet, hypnotic dance.

Every number from 1 upward is drawn as a factorization diagram: nested rings of colored dots that show, at a glance, how that number is built from its prime factors. 6 is two groups of three. 12 is three groups of four. Primes can't be split, so they shimmer alone. Then the diagram melts and re-forms into the next number, and the next, an endless looping dance of arithmetic.

It's equal parts math toy, teaching tool, and ambient art.

WATCH, OR EXPLORE
• Let it play for a calm, continuous dance from one number to the next
• Tap to pause, drag to scrub to any number, or step one at a time
• Speed it up, or slow it right down
• A gentle haptic tap each time the dance lands on a prime

HEAR IT
• Every number sings its factorization: a prime is a single pure tone, a composite a chord of its prime factors
• On by default, off whenever you like

POINT YOUR CAMERA
• Aim Rondo at any printed number and watch its diagram bloom over the page, in augmented reality
• Lift a number's diagram off the page and into the room, then walk around it
• Street signs, receipts, book pages: factor the world around you

EVERY NUMBER HAS A STORY
• Tap any number to see what makes it special: whether it's prime, a perfect number, a power, and more
• Collect the special numbers you find in the Field Guide

SEE THE MATH
• The current number and its factorization, always in view
• Full VoiceOver support and a spoken read-out of each number and how it factors
• Save the numbers you love to Favorites, and share any diagram as an image

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN AND WRIST
• Widgets that turn today's date into factorization diagrams, across the Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy
• A factorization calendar for the month or the current week
• An Apple Watch app: scrub through the numbers with the Digital Crown, with the same prime haptics

MAKE IT YOURS WITH RONDO PRO
A one-time unlock, never a subscription. The full dance stays free. Pro is for going deeper:
• New color palettes, backgrounds, and color styles
• A living clock face that factors the time
• Number sequences: count by multiples, primes only, Fibonacci, and more
• The full instrument: tune the scale, voice, and space of the sound
• Hear any number's story narrated aloud, in your choice of tone

CALM BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No account. No subscription. Rondo is free to play, with an optional one-time Pro unlock.

A LOVING HOMAGE
Rondo is a faithful tribute to Brent Yorgey's factorization diagrams and Stephen Von Worley's animated "Factor Conga," built natively for iOS 26. The diagrams honor their work; the sound, the augmented reality, and the stories are Rondo's own. Full credits are in the app.
